name: Boxer Retail Limited
summary: Boxer Retail Limited engages in the retail of food, health and beauty products, general merchandise, and liquor in South Africa and Eswatini. It is involved in retail operations under the Boxer Superstores, Boxer Build, and Boxer Liquors brands. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Westville, South Africa. Boxer Retail Limited operates as a subsidiary of Pick n Pay Retailers Proprietary Limited.
